  "memo":"R08 holds because four accounts used the shipping address. The address is not the account's home, so the household exception does not apply. Linkage is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, and no earlier outcome settles this order. A gift to a shared destination is plausible, but requires verification rather than dismissal of the linkage evidence. Recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold with id_check. No checks have run. Contact is not required, and decline is not permitted with only Linkage present."
